links.outcome: Guideline adherence and clinical score with retrieval-augmented grounding versus prior stages
links.effect: Final retrieval-grounded variant improved Clinical Score from 0.716 to 0.864 and reached Guideline Score of 0.881; BLEU-4 decreased from 0.371 to 0.272.
links.quote: Staged alignment produced a measurable Alignment Tax: the final retrieval-grounded variant improved the Clinical Score from 0.716 to 0.864 and reached a Guideline Score of 0.881, while BLEU-4 decreased from 0.371 to 0.272.

unlisted_practices: Staged domain adaptation (continual pre-training, SFT, reinforcement policy optimization) for safety alignment of clinical LLMs
Using clinical/guideline metrics instead of language-overlap metrics (BLEU) to evaluate clinical LLM output

screen.reason: Evaluates the addition of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) grounding and safety policy alignment onto an LLM for guideline-directed clinical decision support using retrospective clinical cases.
